requirements: Gate the next case before creating its outcome, starting its case timer, constructing its Provider or making any request.
Bind each create-only ready signal to exact plan, case and running run; reject stale/mismatched/late signals.
Readiness wait consumes the same original batch monotonic deadline, and acceptance is rechecked before the case starts.
No restart/reset/refund of prior time, tokens or calls; prior results and original15 labels stay unchanged.
Preserve the preceding durable completed prefix if the host disappears during readiness wait; do not count an unstarted case as attempted.
Waiting only prevents unacknowledged case transitions; it cannot protect against host loss during an already-started review.
